name: fertrac-lista-precios-android
description: Contenedor Android (Capacitor) de la Lista de Precios Fertrac v2. Carga https://app.fertrac.com/

scripts.add:android: npx cap add android && node scripts/set-version.js
scripts.sync: npx cap sync android && node scripts/set-version.js
scripts.build:release: npx cap sync android && node scripts/set-version.js && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
